Name: GoldTradingMod
Author: GoldenMagikarp0512
Description:
Gold Trading Mode is a multiplayer-focused Stardew Valley mod designed to enable safe and clear player-to-player gold trading without directly transferring gold between players
Instead of moving gold directly, all transactions are handled through currency items and an ATM system, which avoids common multiplayer issues such as desynchronization, duplication, and abuse
Players can purchase currency items of various denominations using an ATM object, store them in their inventory, and exchange them with other players as needed
Currency items are clearly separated from normal items using a dedicated context tag, ensuring they are only used for trading and exchange purposes
All gold changes and world-affecting actions are processed in a host-authoritative manner
In multiplayer sessions, guest players send transaction requests to the host, and the host verifies and finalizes each transaction before syncing the result back to all players
This approach ensures consistent behavior across clients and prevents unintended gold generation or loss
The ATM is a craftable BigCraftable object that serves as the central interface for buying and exchanging currency
Placed ATMs can be picked up again using a pickaxe or axe, and in multiplayer the host always has final authority over ATM placement and removal to keep the world state stable
The ATM UI is fully custom and does not rely on the vanilla ShopMenu selling logic
It features a scrollable list of currency denominations, clear action buttons for buying, selling a single item, or selling all held currency, and omits unnecessary price displays since value is based entirely on denomination
Gold Trading Mode is built with Stardew Valley 1.6.x and SMAPI multiplayer synchronization rules in mind, making it a reliable foundation for cooperative play where players want structured, abuse-resistant money trading without sharing a single wallet
